about: Enthalpy of formation printed in an open doctoral thesis, read in the thesis PDF (pdftotext): printed page 58, 'ΔfH°(liq, 298.15 K) = -417.6 +- 1.4 kJ/mol for hydroxymethyl furfural from our previous work [104]'; the thesis's reference [104] is Verevkin, Emel'yanenko, Stepurko, Ralys, Zaitsau, Stark, Biomass-Derived Platform Chemicals: Thermodynamic Studies on the Conversion of 5-Hydroxymethylfurfural into Bulk Intermediates, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 48 (2009) 10087-10093 (paywalled; its free supporting information does not hold this value). The state is the liquid: HMF melts at 308.5 K, so at 298.15 K the liquid is supercooled; CHEPTA's records of HMF take that liquid as their reference state, and the maintainer chose this value (2026-10-27). The uncertainty is as printed, its coverage not stated.

source.citation: I. V. Andreeva, Development of thermodynamic frameworks for the reliable prediction of properties of key compounds and intermediates obtained from biomass, doctoral thesis, Universitaet Rostock (2021)
source.access: Open thesis, free to read in RosDok, the repository of the University of Rostock
source.tables: Table D.1 (printed page 145), levoglucosenone (liquid), enthalpy of formation at 298.15 K
